---
title: "Compare pitch speed and elbow moment"
subtitle: "Each point represents one pitch-level trial"
---

The plot compares pitch speed with peak elbow varus moment. Hover over a point
to see its trial ID and measurements; use the legend to focus on throwing-hand
groups, and zoom or pan to inspect dense regions.

Pitch speed is measured in miles per hour (mph). Peak elbow varus moment is a
twisting effect around the elbow, measured in newton-metres (Nm); positive
values indicate varus and negative values indicate valgus under this dataset's
sign convention. It is a biomechanical estimate, not a direct measurement of
tissue damage.

```{r}
#| label: fig-pitch-speed-moment
#| fig-cap: "Pitch speed and peak elbow varus moment for each pitching trial. The line summarizes the overall linear trend; it is descriptive, not causal."
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 6

library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)

data_url <- paste0(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/drivelineresearch/openbiomechanics/",
  "main/baseball_pitching/data/poi/poi_metrics.csv"
)

pitch_data <- read_csv(
  data_url,
  col_select = c(
    session_pitch,
    p_throws,
    pitch_speed_mph,
    elbow_varus_moment
  ),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(pitch_speed_mph),
    !is.na(elbow_varus_moment)
  )

plot <- ggplot(
  pitch_data,
  aes(
    x = pitch_speed_mph,
    y = elbow_varus_moment,
    color = p_throws,
    text = paste(
      "Trial:", session_pitch,
      "<br>Throwing hand:", p_throws,
      "<br>Pitch speed:", pitch_speed_mph, "mph",
      "<br>Peak elbow varus moment:", elbow_varus_moment, "Nm"
    )
  )
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.75, size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(
    aes(group = 1),
    method = "lm",
    se = TRUE,
    color = "#C45435",
    linewidth = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("R" = "#176B87", "L" = "#C45435"),
    labels = c("R" = "Right-handed", "L" = "Left-handed")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Pitch speed (mph)",
    y = "Peak elbow varus moment (Nm)",
    color = "Throwing hand"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

ggplotly(plot, tooltip = "text")
```

The file contains **`r format(nrow(pitch_data), big.mark = ",")`** trials
with both measurements. In this release all are fastballs, so this chart does
not compare pitch types. The line and points describe an association in these
trials only; they do not show that throwing faster causes a higher moment, or
that either measure predicts injury.

The source defines `elbow_varus_moment` as peak elbow varus moment in
newton-metres (Nm). See the [data dictionary](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/drivelineresearch/openbiomechanics/main/baseball_pitching/data/data_dictionary.csv)
and the [pitch-level data file](https://github.com/drivelineresearch/openbiomechanics/blob/main/baseball_pitching/data/poi/poi_metrics.csv).
